name: PiinPoint
long_description: PiinPoint is changing the way businesses identify the best location for expansion. Our modern day SAAS solution enables businesses to use powerful tools to search and validate locations throughout North America. We centralize a variety of datasets such as traffic, demographics, and available commercial real estate to ensure businesses can make a fast and reliable decision about where to expand.
one_liner: PiinPoint helps businesses find the best locations for growth

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Jim Robeson is the Co-founder and CEO of PiinPoint, a location analytics solution that helps retailers identify and predict the financial performance of future store locations. Since its launch in 2014, more than 250,000 locations have been analyzed using PiinPoint’s services.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Adam Saunders is the Co-founder and CTO of PiinPoint, a location analytics solution that helps businesses with Commercial Real Estate portfolios identify opportunities and predict the financial performance of future locations. Since its launch in 2014, millions of locations have been analyzed using PiinPoint’s services.
